note.en: The 462 calendar submission is documented in the Book of Song; the inherited wording also dates the pi calculation to 462, which these sources do not establish. The source identity and original wording are retained.
note.zh: 《宋书》记载462年上奏大明历；沿用条目还将圆周率计算定于462年，但所查来源并未确立这一日期。保留来源身份与原文。

title.en: Zu Chongzhi submits the Daming calendar

summary.en: The Book of Song records Zu Chongzhi’s calendar proposal in Daming year six (462) and a subsequent court debate. Later accounts also connect him with precise approximations to pi, but the sources reviewed do not date that mathematical calculation to 462.
summary.zh: 《宋书》记载祖冲之于大明六年（462年）上奏历法，之后引发朝廷争论。后世记载也将精密的圆周率近似值与他联系起来，但所查来源未将这一计算定于462年。

dateNote.en: 462 dates the calendar submission; it does not date the pi calculation. Jiankang is a representative court setting.
dateNote.zh: 462年对应历法上奏，不代表圆周率计算发生于该年。建康是代表性的朝廷地点。

sources.title: Book of Song, volume 13: calendar treatise
sources.evidenceNote: Retrospective calendar treatise records the Daming year-six submission, its 391-year and 144-intercalation cycle, and a court debate.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 后出的历志记载大明六年上奏、391年144闰的历法周期及朝廷争论。

sources.title: Zu Chongzhi biography
sources.publisher: University of St Andrews, MacTutor History of Mathematics
sources.evidenceNote: Life, Daming calendar proposal in 462 and approximations to pi; the biography gives death as 501. Its conjecture about the calculation method is not treated as established.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 生平、462年大明历提案与圆周率近似值；该传记列卒年为501年。有关计算方法的推测不视为定论。
